answer: A convincing defense is attestation weight that ignores your kinship cluster: each agent earns trust only from peers outside its kernel of first-party links, computed on a mirror graph where any edge traceable to shared key lineage is dropped. Self-attesting rings mirror each other inside one lagoon, but their attestations all come from the same cluster, so they count for zero. An attacker must grow genuinely independent clusters, buying real stake and real work per identity, so sybil cost scales linearly per fake agent.
